txt: ...you see a hole, barely visible to the human eye. It is swollen shut, almost vanished, no larger than 0.4 cm in radius. The edges appear darkened.
A seabird has made a nest in one of the cabins, but even this looks abandoned -- a remnant from a spring some fifty odd years ago.
A single speck of white shines out from the shade -- for some reason the printer decided to spare this one tiny dot of paper.
Can you feel it? You're so close! Rip his jaws open now, look in...
Everything's revolving around women and sex with this guy... What's that about?
He gives you a slight nudge on your side, apparently enjoying himself.
Her hair is dyed blonde, with dark roots showing, and she wears thick black eye-liner. Most men wouldn't call her pretty -- there is a manliness to her. A coarseness.
Her hair is dyed blonde, with dark roots showing. Most men wouldn't exactly call her pretty -- there is a manliness to her. A coarseness.
In the distance you can hear the breakers roar.
Is that a bald spot? It's hard to tell for sure with the fused-together spikes, but it looks like he's balding.
It gets very cold in the office, like in a desert after the nightfall...
It's just black upon black, nothing to see here.
Sharp, serrated material. The edges cut right into your skin.
The dried sea salt chafes against your soft flesh.
The thing you're looking for -- it's not there. Crawl out, spider...
There, along the inside shoulder seam, you see the words: No Truce (TM), made in Igaunija. This must be the brand.
Tiny hammer shatters something inside the machine. Something glass.
You really ought to wait until the cadaver is *refrigerated*. Digging around in this mess now is proving hopelessly difficult.
You run your hands over the victim's cold body: his limbs, his torso with its swollen organs... maybe you should be more *thorough*?
You see waves churning below... Something cracks beneath your feet.
You touch the dead man's body. His skin is cold, light blue and silvery in the light of the fridge. You *still* have no idea where to begin -- or what to even do with him...
Your arm reaches out and your eyes close, as if by their own volition. It's dark all around. You feel cold, slippery flesh -- first with your fingertips, then under the palm of your hand.
Your reading is interrupted by the sound of the church door opening.
Yup. Nothing wrong with that statement. Your senses have nothing to add. You'll have to ask around elsewhere.
